title: Module manifest (module.yaml)
description: What a module declares: its name, version and capabilities. See spec/modules.md.

name.description: Identifies the module in a node and prefixes its capabilities. node, network and module are reserved.

entities.description: The types of records the module keeps in its node's store.

$defs.description: Schemas the capabilities' schemas refer to, as #/$defs/<name>.

name.description: Unique in the module. Called as <module>.<name>.

access.description: local: only the node itself, its modules and tools. network: other nodes too.

internal.description: Part of a protocol between modules: not announced to other nodes, nor listed by tools.

input.description: JSON Schema of the call's input. Unset means any object.

output.description: JSON Schema of the call's result. Unset means any object.

schema.description: JSON Schema of the records. Unset means any object.

indexes.description: Top-level fields records can be queried and sorted by, besides their ID.

schema.description: A JSON Schema (2020-12) of an object.
